skillset.skill: 13s CT - 4000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 10s, reduce enemies' Evasion rate by 30%.
skillset.arts: 22000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 30s, reduce enemies' PHY RES and Earth RES by 40%.
skillset.protagonize: Can be activated instead of Arts - Increase the final DMG dealt to enemies by 1.3x, and halves allies' Break Power and HP Recovery Amount.
skillset.truearts: 100000% Earth DMG (PHY). From the second activation of True Arts onwards, permanently adds 40000% to True Arts' DMG Multiplier (MAX: 200000% additional). Additionally if used when True Arts' DMG Multiplier is not at its MAX, increase own Arts by 100.
skillset.superarts: 140000% Earth DMG (PHY). When Super Arts is activated, reduce own remaining Equip CT by half. For 35s, allies gain a DMG barrier that negates 20000 DMG and increase allies' PHY RES by 40%.

passive.ability1:
When ownself is Leader, increase own Arts by 5/s and increase allies' Freeze RES and Paralysis RES by 100%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type EX1 and will not stack with other Type EX1 Arts Gen.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by 30% against enemies below 30% HP.
passive.ability3: Increase allies' MAX HP by 10%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Wolfrid's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Wolfrid's SP. Art is owned)
